subclass.quote:
Django comes with built-in database backends. You may subclass an existing
database backends to modify its behavior, features, or configuration.

private.quote: if any method starts with a single ``_``, it's an internal API.

cache.quote:
Django provides the :data:`django.test.signals.setting_changed`
signal that lets you register callbacks to clean up and otherwise reset state
when settings are changed.

destroy.quote:
Destroys the database whose name is the value of :setting:`NAME` in
    :setting:`DATABASES`, and sets :setting:`NAME` to the value of
    ``old_database_name``.

teardown.quote: Destroys the test databases, restoring pre-test conditions.

threads.quote:
A `ConnectionPool` object can be used to request connections from multiple
concurrent threads.

closed.quote:
All the waiting and future clients will fail to acquire a connection
        with a `PoolClosed` exception.

runtime-settings.quote: You shouldn't alter settings in your applications at runtime.

isolation.quote:
If you need a higher isolation level such as ``REPEATABLE READ`` or
``SERIALIZABLE``, set it in the :setting:`OPTIONS` part of your database
configuration in :setting:`DATABASES`

return-checkout.quote: After using this function you *must* call a corresponding `putconn()`:

postgres-current.quote: It cannot be executed while you are connected to the target database.

previous-database.quote:
Connect to the previous database (not the test database)
        # to do so, because it's not allowed to delete a database while being
        # connected to it.
